scientific_protocol: Per field and actual source geometry: upper flat grip and marker slope, upper/lower real bend, both y-rims, right meridian, both turned head interiors, both regular cap centers and two analytic cap interiors, two signed seam-speed extrema on each cap. Add every available actual independent-check Killing, chart speed, curvature, support and fixed Gram extremum plus three chart-group Killing extrema. Each address runs both integrators across the whole interval.
canonical_point_words: Each actual physical coefficient vector z and intrinsic material vector x has its own scientific SHA. The complete point is their ordered concatenation (z,x). Each whole stage NPZ and the full summary have independent recorded lengths and SHA-256.

stage_source.program: Five initial material vector solves, two complete joint layers in each of two geometry classes, and two same-source metric layers on the selected geometry. Up to eleven returned stages.
stage_source.frozen_target: induced Gram of the immutable true geometric source at its recorded selected physical coefficients and degree; both subsequent layers use the same full material target.

selected_parent_target.definition: One complete selected unmarked physical pullback tensor in the original fixed material atlas, exact chart/geometry formulas and recorded physical polynomial coefficients. Same top marker graph metric on its fixed domain; no per-radius re-fit, no Haar quadrature or target interpolation.
selected_parent_target.open_cost: A full-group invariance of the frozen source is not presumed. Fixed refinement charges both its base tensor mismatch and the actual material Lie derivative of the candidate metric for finite-time control.

output_contract.scientific_summary: Report a separate parent replay identity and timing, every original/replay stage identity difference and each actual flow point. Report coarse/fine pullback errors and actual crossing, basis and endpoint differences, preserving failed attempts.
output_contract.raw_fields: Full regenerated NPZ coordinates, trajectories, failed partial time histories and detailed scalar logs stay on the runner. Publish point identities and complete per-point raw-file length and SHA.
output_contract.public_attempt: notes/run39b-bent-body-flow-<run>-<attempt>.json and one marked H line after checked pull/rebase, inclusive topic capacity accounting.
output_contract.success: Field equality and velocity alone provide no global metric, reach, held, Euclidean quotient, control of unsampled material or interval certificate.
